主要内容: Asta Funding, Inc. issued a press release announcing the extension of its self-tender offer to repurchase up to 5,314,009 shares of its common stock at a price of $10.35 per share. The press release is filed as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference into this Current Report on Form 8-K. The company's Chief Financial Officer, Bruce R. Foster, signed the report on behalf of the registrant on February 2, 2017. The tender offer extension is a corporate action related to the company's financial services industry, impacting its equity structure and shareholder base. The event occurred on February 2, 2017, and is relevant to the company's operations in the United States market.
